summary: Executed bounded workflow repairs after attempt 01's inventory timeout; preserved passing regressions, both consumed reservations, original failed history and the separately recovered valid response.
findings: Timeout is a provider execution failure, not a conclusion about the circular.
Dependent generation now stops after a missing inventory; pair batches preserve complete coverage.
Live cap, recovery identity, date invalidation and deadline boundaries have regression tests.
failure: Attempt 01 passed 369 regression tests, then its first source inventory hit the 180-second call timeout. The supervisor was stopped while the second independent inventory was in flight. The second call completed with a valid contract and is retained separately. Both live reservations remain consumed (43/100 used).
repairs: Stop dependent candidate generation if either required source inventory is absent.
Bound fidelity output to exact batches of 32 pairs without dropping required checks.
Keep model/provider route; permit 300 seconds per live call for this repaired pilot. No claim that model effort caused the timeout.
Enforce the 77-total increment ceiling atomically in the existing shared allowance, without altering its authorized maximum of 100.
Reuse the recovered slot-43 response only for exact request/schema equality with explicit prior-call provenance; preserve attempt 01 unchanged.
Reserve projected pair checks and final criticism before optional repair. Bound pilot search at six candidates/five calls; limits remain reported uncertainty.
Include the evaluation date in monitoring revisions so a date change invalidates an otherwise unchanged investigation.
changes: Executed the repairs listed above; added recovery, pair-coverage, deadline, increment-cap and evaluation-date regression cases. Each in-flight provider call is capped by its remaining run deadline.
regression: 30 targeted tests passed before the additional small deadline check; the successor runs the full test suite, including that new check, before any live dispatch.

skeptical_audit.baseline: P12 and attempt-01 regression preserved; no changing comparator or treating tests as legal truth
skeptical_audit.defaults: Timeout, batch size and search caps are explicit resource hypotheses; no efficacy ranking
skeptical_audit.stop_conditions: Local, overall and atomic shared limits; no dependent generation after missing inventory; no unsupported clean result
skeptical_audit.environment: Same reviewed Codex route and JDK, approved trusted runner, public sources only
skeptical_audit.acceptance: Targeted recovery/batching/date tests and full successor regression; same seeded omission versus clean-control criterion
skeptical_audit.artifacts: Append-only A7 successor attempt, exact input hashes, retained slot-43 recovery record and unchanged original failure
